bio.text: Mark Takano represents California's 39th Congressional District in the U.S. House and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He was born in Riverside, California, in 1960, and earned a bachelor's degree in government from Harvard University in 1983 and an M.F.A. in creative writing from UC Riverside in 2010.
He previously worked as a teacher.
